WITH create_graph_id AS (
  SELECT symbol_id
  FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols
  WHERE name = 'create_graph'
),
create_graph_calls AS (
  SELECT c.call_id, c.caller_symbol_id, c.callee_symbol_id, c.call_kind, c.line,
         s.name, s.qualname, s.kind
  FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls c
  JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.symbols s ON c.callee_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
  WHERE c.caller_symbol_id = (SELECT symbol_id FROM create_graph_id)
)

WITH create_graph_sym AS (
    SELECT symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols
    WHERE name = 'create_graph'
      AND qualname LIKE '%text_to_sql_graph%'
    LIMIT 1
),
callback_calls AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls c
    JOIN create_graph_sym s ON c.caller_symbol_id = s.symbol_id
    WHERE c.call_kind = 'callback'
      AND c.callee_symbol_id != s.symbol_id
)
SELECT symbol_id
FROM callback_calls
ORDER BY symbol_id;
